message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules (for a standard 108‑card deck)** | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or play a set number of rounds). Points are earned by being the first to discard all your cards in each round. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face down as the draw pile.
• Turn over the top card to start the discard pile; if it’s an action card, follow its effect before play begins. | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a direction‑changing card is played). On a turn you may:
1. **Play** one card from your hand that matches the color, number, or symbol of the top discard.
2. **Draw** one card from the draw pile if you cannot play. If the drawn card is playable, you may immediately play it. | | **Playable Cards** | • **Number cards** (0–9) – match by number or color.
• **Action cards** – match by color or symbol:
 - **Skip** – next player loses a turn.
 - **Reverse** – changes play direction.
 - **Draw Two (+2)** – next player draws two cards and skips a turn.
 - **Wild** – you choose the new color.
 - **Wild Draw Four (+4)** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and skips a turn (must be challenged if you suspect you could have played another card). | | **Special Rules** | • **Challenge** – If a Wild Draw Four is played, the next player may challenge. If the challenger was wrong, they draw six cards; if correct, the original player draws six instead.
• **UNO Call** – When you have one card left, shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and someone else notices before the next player plays, you must draw two cards as a penalty. | | **Scoring** | At the end of a round, the winner scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards still held by the other players:
• Number cards = face value.
• Skip, Reverse, Draw Two = 20 points each.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points each.
Points are added to the winner’s total. | | **Winning** | First player to reach 500 points (or the agreed target) wins the game. | --- ### Quick Play Summary 1. **Deal** 7 cards each. 2. Flip top card → start discard pile. 3. Clockwise turns: play matching card or draw. 4. Use action cards to affect opponents. 5. Call “UNO” when you’re down to one card. 6. Finish round when someone discards all cards. 7. Score based on opponents’ remaining cards. 8. Repeat until a player reaches the target score. Enjoy!
